xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi:
The Company During the quarter ended on June 30, 2026, has issued 13,00,000 Equity share having face value of Rs.10/- each to the Non-Promoters and 27,77,919 Fully Convertible Warrants with a right to the warrant holders to apply for and be allotted 1 Equity Share of face value of Rs. 10/- each of the Company within a period of 18months from the date of allotment of the Warrants.
The Company has received Trading approval for 13,00,000 Equity shares during the quarter ended on June 30, 2026 from National Stock Exchange Limited and BSE Limited.
Further, the Company shall on receipt of request from warrant holders allot the Equity shares and shall be apply for listing and trading approval in due course.
